import.policy: verbatim import; narrow, story-documented deviations listed under 'deviations' — behavior forks keep the original behind #if NETFRAMEWORK (never compiles here); trivial mechanical fixes such as path separators may replace lines directly
import.verification: Files not named under 'deviations' must match upstream.sourceTree; deviating files are accounted for individually. The product project compiles the full tree minus the excluded files listed in Rehost.Web.Services.csproj.

deviations.reason: Assembly.Evidence and XmlSerializer.FromMappings(mappings, Evidence) were cut from modern .NET; every call sat on the dead non-homogenous-AppDomain branch (AppDomain.IsHomogenous is constant true)

WSDL proxy generation (T4) is blocked on System.Xml.Serialization code-export APIs cut from modern .NET; ServiceDescriptionImporter fails fast, encoded-WSDL generation throws PlatformNotSupportedException
the VS debugger-causality COM channel (RemoteDebugger/Interop) is not compiled; a port-owned stub with permanently closed gates stands in
DynamicVirtualDiscoSearcher (IIS-metabase discovery over ADSI) is not compiled; the virtual-search path throws PlatformNotSupportedException

SetDefaults appends a literal backslash to the machine-config directory; on Unix that embeds into the help-page physical path and no file matches (help page 404). Path.DirectorySeparatorChar behind #if !NETFRAMEWORK
GetRelativePath built .discomap relative paths with literal backslashes; off Windows results carried rooted or absolute paths. Path.DirectorySeparatorChar, direct replacement

the Hidden bit of the directory check asks HiddenFile (linked from the runtime), under which a leading dot alone does not hide a folder off Windows; System and Temporary are unchanged. Direct replacement
